data.title: Welcome to the Wild Ten: Play For Free until December 5!
data.content:
The Autumn Update is live in War Robots: Frontiers, and you can play for free until December 5! Whether you’re a Pioneer or a new player, try out this update and the full Early Access experience via MY.GAMES Launcher or the Free Trial version on Steam. 

GRIFFIN EVENT (NOV 28–DEC 5)

Receive a daily gift by logging in to War Robots: Frontiers and playing one battle every day from November 28–December 5, including:

  • Robot Parts: Construct a monstrous Griffin build.
  • Weapons: Amp up your damage with the mighty autocannon Punisher and rocket-launching Orkan.
  • New Ability: Fling foes back with the Blast Wave.

Rewards claimed are subject to a progress wipe with Open Beta.

Subscribe to the official War Robots: Frontiers newsletter to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on Twitter and Facebook, and join the official Discord server. You can also follow War Robots: Frontiers on Steam to get the latest news there.
